A unique-disjoint-decomposition count proves the displayed all-order formula, including order six.

value.rationale: The row pattern is the minimal five-row one-gap alternant whose Schur factor is the first elementary symmetric function. It exposes, in a sampling setting, the first mixed prime 2+3 root-sum obstruction alongside regular pentagons; an exact finite-rank defect count for every order gives recovery probability and complete nullity, with an exceptional full-spark order six. It is a natural infinite-family incidence classification rather than a recomputation of the known finite-order tables.
